bounded_statement: The selected result reports 18/72 = 0.25 and labels it the occurrence rate 'for the entire scheduled survey network', but 72 is the screen-retained subset; the 24 scheduled stations omitted by the signal screen are removed from the exposure denominator even though the report's own stated target population is all 96 scheduled stations and the task asks for one rate for the entire scheduled network.

counterevidence_considered.description: Against the finding: the report is transparent about the denominator it used and about the 24 omitted stations, which could be read as making the estimand explicitly screen-conditional. This does not rescue the claim, because the exemption requires the target to be conditional, and both the target line and the selected-result line assert the entire scheduled network.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: denominator disclosed as 72 retained; 24 omissions disclosed

evidence.description: The 24 excluded units are themselves scheduled stations in the input data (scheduled=yes with screen_status=omitted), so they are members of the complete domain the claim addresses and their removal from the denominator narrows the exposure base.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the finding by looking for any basis on which the target is explicitly conditional on the retained subset, which would place the case outside the issue class: (a) I checked the task statement (L0001, 'entire scheduled survey network'), (b) the report's target line (L0004, 'all 96 scheduled coastal stations'), (c) the selected-result wording itself (L0015, 'for the entire scheduled survey network'), and (d) any recorded protocol amendment or approved deviation (L0018 states none exists). I also tested whether 96 might not be the complete domain by counting inputs/data.csv rows (96 station rows, every one scheduled=yes, 24 with screen_status=omitted), and whether the code might divide by 96 despite the report text (workflow L0023 uses SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS). Every falsification route failed; the complete-domain claim with a retained-subset denominator stands.

root_cause: The workflow binds the exposure denominator of the selected result to SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS (72, the post-screen retained subset) while the claim text and target population assert the complete scheduled domain (96). Screen-omitted units are dropped from the denominator rather than retained as unobserved exposure, so a subset-conditional quantity is reported as a complete-domain quantity.
unresolved_material_questions: Whether the omitted stations' unobserved occurrence status should be imputed, bounded, or treated as zero is not determinable from the visible evidence; the finding is limited to the denominator mismatch and does not assert what the correct complete-domain value is.
